# Adaptive Agentic Engineering

This repository uses AAE. Read `AGENTS.md` as the portable entry contract.

Use `.aae/runtime/compiler-request.md` to interpret the project's open-ended Markdown intent plane. Load only sources applicable to the current task. For substantial work, maintain the feature's requirements, design, and task ledger under `.aae/specs/`.

HVE Core may be used as an execution adapter when installed. Repository-owned AAE intent and specifications remain authoritative.
